masterData.varietiesIntro: The full variety record — public profile, detector mapping, and reference dimensions used for grading.
masterData.searchPlaceholder: Search name, scientific name, or class
masterData.descriptionPlaceholder: Notes inspectors will see in the catalog
masterData.imageHint: Public URL — paste a hero image link or leave blank for the family-tinted placeholder.
masterData.invalidClass: Detector class must be a whole number.
masterData.invalidLength: Reference length must be a positive number.
masterData.invalidWidth: Reference width must be a positive number.

hyperparams.title: Model hyperparameters
hyperparams.intro: Tune the live + single-shot inference thresholds and live fps for QA. Settings persist across reloads; tap Reset to revert to defaults.
hyperparams.scoreThresholdHint: Drop detections below this score before NMS. Higher = fewer false positives.
hyperparams.iouThresholdHint: JS-side NMS overlap cutoff. YOLO26 (NMS-baked) ignores this.
hyperparams.targetFpsHint: Worklet inference rate for both iOS Core ML and Android TFLite (GPU). 30 fps matches camera native rate.
hyperparams.resetBody: All values revert to the shipped defaults.
hyperparams.inferenceStatsHint: Rolling p50 / p95 / p99 over the last ~100 inferences per delegate. Shape your fps target against the p95, not the p50.

models.title: Model registry
models.intro: Browse deployed registry models, install validated Android TFLite or iOS Core ML artifacts, activate a model, or roll back to the previous active model. Bundled weights remain the fallback.
models.endpointHint: Uses the dashboard deployment API by default; paste a local HTTP model index only for offline testing.
models.noCandidates: Enter a local HTTP index URL and refresh.
models.noRollback: No previous active model is available.

update.title: New model {{semver}} available
update.subtitle: Tap install to download and activate.
update.subtitleWithSize: {{size}} MB · tap install to download and activate.

models.noActive: No model installed yet — tap Check for updates.
models.deleteConfirmBody: Model files will be removed from this device. You can re-download from the registry at any time.
models.noCandidatesForChannel: No models available in this channel yet.
models.candidateMissing: That update is no longer available — refresh and try again.
models.alreadyInstalled: That model is already installed. Activate it from the list below.
